title: Branch protection
description: Branch protection rules, keyed by branch name. Set to null (~) to remove all managed branch protection. See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#branchpro

branchProtectionRules.description: Protection rules for a single branch. The presence of the required_pull_request_reviews and required_status_checks sections is what enables those protections.

required_conversation_resolution.description: Require all review conversations to be resolved before merging.

required_status_checks.description: Require status checks to pass before merging. An empty section removes the status check requirement.

strict.description: Require branches to be up to date with the base branch before merging.

contexts.description: Status check contexts that must pass, regardless of which app reports them.

checks.description: Status checks that must pass, optionally pinned to the GitHub App that reports them.

context.description: Name of the status check context.

app_id.description: Numeric id of the GitHub App that must report the check. -1 accepts any source.

requiredPullRequestReviews.description: Require pull request reviews before merging.

dismiss_stale_reviews.description: Dismiss approving reviews when new commits are pushed.

require_code_owner_reviews.description: Require a review from a code owner.

require_last_push_approval.description: Require an approval from someone other than the last pusher.
